intro: Tucked away in the secluded Crystal Vale of northwestern Silithus, the Ravaged Twilight Camp sits ruined among towering mineral formations. It serves as an isolated redoubt for the eccentric hermit Highlord Demitrian, a devotee of the Windseeker.

sections.t: A Hermit's Ruin in the Vale
p: While the Twilight's Hammer maintains numerous active outposts across the sands of Silithus, this broken encampment in the Crystal Vale tells a different story. Nestled far from the primary cult fortresses, the camp lies largely ruined and deserted, save for Highlord Demitrian. A servant of Thunderaan, Demitrian lingers amidst the stones, seemingly abandoned by or detached from the wider Twilight hierarchy while brooding over elemental bindings and the lost power of the Windseeker.
